chunks: They still exist in the loins of men and wombs of women. Whenever a chief would appear from among them he would be cut down till the last of them would turn thieves and robbers.

key_terms.نُطَفٌ: Semen/seed, referring to progeny in the loins

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the Kharijites after their initial defeat?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) uses the metaphor of 'nutfah' (embryonic drop) to signify that the Kharijite ideology persists in the lineage of men and women, ensuring its recurrence. He predicts a gradual degeneration where their leaders are successively eliminated until the final remnant devolves into mere thieves and robbers, illustrating the inevitable decline of their distinct faction. This reflects the Shia understanding of cyclical historical patterns where ideological deviations eventually lose their political potency and become social nuisances.
